title: Chalet by the Sea
meta_description: Just a short stroll away from the sugary sand lies this exquisite modern farmhouse that’s the same color as the turquoise Gulf of Mexico. Chalet By The Sea is a magnificent home that’s the perfect place to call home while you relax by the shore.
description_expanded: DescriptionPROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:* 4 Complimentary Beach Cruiser Bikes* Beach Towels Included* Sonos Sound System* 75“ Samsung 4k TV, Apple TV, Logitech Remote* Professionally designed* Lots of parking* Private, heated pool (Pool heat may be added for $45/day plus tax)* Easy walk to the beachOn a private wooded lot that’s a short stroll away from the sugary sand of the beach lies this exquisite modern farmhouse that’s the same color as the turquoise Gulf of Mexico waters. Chalet By The Sea is a magnificent oasis that’s ideal for large groups and families looking for the perfect place to call home while they relax by the shore. With over 3,000 square feet of luxurious living space, multiple living spaces, four gorgeous bedrooms, and a heated private pool— Chalet By The Sea is sure to become your new happy place on 30A.The cobblestoned driveway welcomes you home and has parking for up to six vehicles. Once inside, the main level great room is completely open and features soaring high ceilings, seafoam green walls, and blond wood floors. In the living area, there’s a comfy sofa and two wingback armchairs facing the fireplace. Around the corner lies a media room with two sleeper-sofas, two swivel chairs, and a huge 75“ 4K TV, . The sofa, chairs, and Sonos sound system make this spot ideal for catching the game or family movie night.Back out in the great room, there’s a formal dining table with space for eight illuminated by an elegant, sparkling chandelier that highlights the unique barrel vault ceiling. Next to the dining area is the kitchen, complete with a spacious island with seating for four. The classic white cabinets surround a full suite of premier appliances— including 2 GE Monogram wall ovens, a gas range with a griddle, a spacious refrigerator, a dishwasher, and a microwave drawer. If you want to whip up some fresh banana pancakes in the morning or some refreshing frozen margaritas at happy hour— this kitchen is equipped with everything you’ll need.Four serene bedroom suites provide plenty of personal space for even large groups. The primary bedroom suite is located on the main level and includes a luxe king-size bed set into a sculpted metal frame and two plush armchairs. The spa-inspired primary ensuite bathroom features a double marble vanity facing a wall of mirrors, and step-in, glass-enclosed shower. The second suite is on the upper level, and also features a king-size bed and an attached full bathroom. The final two bedrooms have a king-size bed and queen-size bed and share a full bathroom.Chalet By The Sea was designed to take full advantage of its stunningly beautiful location. There are multiple outdoor living spaces— including a meditation terrace and a pergola-covered porch with a teak table for alfresco dining. French doors off of the great room lead outside to the backyard and the zen-like heated swimming pool that’s surrounded by swaying palm trees and tropical flowering vines.Every single detail has been thought of and provided at Chalet By The Sea— including a large laundry room, lightning-fast Wifi, and even an outdoor shower. You’ll also be about a 5-minute stroll from the beach, and a quick bike ride or drive to charming Seaside, Alys, or Rosemary Beach for dining and shopping. Chalet By The Sea is 30A coastal living at its very best.HOME LAYOUT: (Sleeps 10)MAIN FLOOR* GREAT ROOM with LIVING AND DINING AREAS* MEDIA ROOM with 2 Queen Sleeper Sofa Beds (Sleeps 4)* Gorgeous, gourmet KITCHEN* PRIMARY SUITE with a king-size bed and ensuite BATH (Sleeps 2)* Powder Room BATHROOM* LAUNDRY ROOM* Large DECK with dining area* Private, heated SWIMMING POOL* OUTDOOR SHOWER* Spacious DRIVEWAY and one GARAGESECOND FLOOR* SECONDARY SUITE with a King-size bed and ensuite BATH (Sleeps 2)* GUEST BEDROOM with King-size bed and SHARED BATH (Sleeps 2)* GUEST BEDROOM with Queen-size bed and SHARED BATH (Sleeps 2)* OFFICE with deskTDT-089744
